moves.title: The Sound
moves.why: Every quilt starts with the water: open Sound in the top corner, the shoreline only hinted, so the room has somewhere to go.

moves.title: The Shoal
moves.why: Beside the open water the bottom rises: the pale reef that dries at low water, rock awash — this lane measured it against the chart.
